text:
Mira Valdez: Quick kickoff 1: Northshore asked for a small-footprint pilot in St. Johns (Nova Scotia colo). Request: 2 reserved A100-eq nodes, CMK cross-account, marketplace tile, brief co-announcement. Target soft-launch: 2025-02-14. Who takes quota, marketplace, legal?

Ben Carter: Ill file the quota. Need SKU and rough qps/tokens by EOD. Prefer Dedicated with a single burst node.

Northshore - Carlos: Baseline 6k req/day, peak 25k. Avg 180 tokens/request, peaks 700. SKUs: a100e-48g x2 + burst x1. AWS ca-central-1. Assets + compliance docs incoming 2024-12-19.

Sana Iqbal: Marketplace lead 1: Ill draft tile once assets arrive. Need logo SVG, PNG social image, 150-word blurb, and approved security claims. ETA 3 business days after assets.

Ben Carter: Opening cloud ticket: CREQ-NS-9001. Requesting 2 reserved a100e-48g + 1 burst. Start 2025-01-12, duration 3 months. Link: https://console.cloud.example/CREQ-NS-9001

infra-bot: Provision plan created: `stjohns-pilot-v1`  status: awaiting quota approval.

Mira Valdez: Security note: cross-account CMK OK but we need grant policy, key ARN, and rotation cadence. Also require VPC peering + flow logs. Please add to onboarding checklist.

Northshore - Carlos: We will provide cross-account key grants, quarterly rotation, and SOC2 Type II attestation.

legal-ops: We need a one-paragraph announcement draft and the exact security claims you intend to publish. Legal review ETA: 3 business days after submission.

Ben Carter: CREQ-NS-9001 submitted. Estimated approval 5 business days. Ill post updates here.

Sana Iqbal: Draft marketplace copy (v0): "Northshore + Redwood pilot: low-latency St. Johns edge for latency-sensitive LLM workloads. Dedicated GPUs, customer-managed keys, private peering." Feedback?

Northshore - Carlos: Fine, please add: "Pilot availability; enterprise onboarding supported."

Mira Valdez: Backup plan: if quotas delay, run pilot on Hosted smaller nodes (2x rtx-eq) and delay marketplace tile. Ben, will you own fallback?

Ben Carter: Yes, Ill own fallback provisioning and routing changes.

Mira Valdez: Recap action items: Ben -> CREQ-NS-9001 monitor + fallback; Sana -> marketplace draft after assets; Legal -> DPA addendum + PR review; Security -> add KMS checklist to onboarding doc. Internal review cutoff: 2025-01-28. Next sync Tue 14:00 UTC.

Northshore - Carlos: Assets upload planned for 2024-12-19, legal contact will follow via email.

Mira Valdez: Thanks all, please keep updates in-thread.
